domain_rationale: Correctness is decided by a crop-hail insurer's loss-adjustment practice: how sample-plot stand counts and defoliation are averaged across a field, how a growth-stage chart turns defoliation into lost yield on the surviving stand only, minimum-loss, straight and disappearing deductibles, indemnity as a share of liability, replant payments and a minimum claim. The deliverable is the claim payment an insurance claims office adjudicates, not software behaviour for its own sake. No task in workspace/tasks, workspace/dropped or workspace/revision adjusts crop insurance or hail claims (grep 'hail' over all three found nothing); the accepted reference crop-water-balance schedules irrigation (Science/Earth, an agronomy water balance), a different domain, deliverable and rule set; health-plan cost sharing and workers-comp benefits are other insurance lines with no plot, stage or crop mechanics.
evidence: instruction.md: the procedure is 'the authority for these insurance claims'; symptoms are claim-statement outcomes (patchy fields, leaf damage, stand plus leaf over-payment, deductibles, cent shortfalls, small losses and claims paid)

environment/app/docs/loss-adjustment-procedure.md: a numbered loss-adjustment procedure (hail-thinned plot, replanted field, liability; plot averaging, leaf-loss chart, minimum loss, deductible options, indemnity, replant payment, minimum claim)
planned verifier: whole-statement comparison against expectations sealed from solution/model.py, derived from the procedure
